featured_reviews.name: Rohan Kumbhare
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Zero. A flatline. An institutional failure masquerading as a store.

​Every visit to Dmart Virar East feels less like shopping and more like an endurance test against utter managerial indifference. This is not just a badly run store; it is a depressing testament to corporate contempt for basic human safety and standards.

​The shelves here are not stocked with fresh products—they are graveyards of the forgotten and the expired. Finding a product within its 'use-by' date is a sad, pathetic lottery. We are constantly forced to sort through mounds of substandard, spoiled, and dangerously expired goods, a clear sign that no one, absolutely no one, who works here gives the slightest damn about what they are selling.

​But the real, crushing hopelessness sets in when you deal with the management. After enduring the grim spectacle of their inventory, you raise a complaint, and what you get back is a black hole of apathy. The management is a complete and utter void. Multiple, desperate attempts to inform them of these health hazards—the mold, the outdated items—have been met with the silent, soul-crushing message: Your health does not matter. Your complaint means nothing.

​It is utterly degrading to spend money here knowing that the very people responsible for your purchase are actively ignoring the risk of selling you something that could make you sick. This branch is a pathetic joke, a miserable failure of retail responsibility, and should be shut down before their negligence actually hospitalizes someone. Avoid this depressing health trap at all costs.

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

We are looking forward to serve you again!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I would never prefer this place for fresh vegetables or fruits.
Products seem to be from cold storage, and there is no proper maintenance or cleanliness.
Instead, I prefer Star Bazaar, which is much better in terms of quality and hygiene.

Regards,
Team SMART Bazaar.
